title: Do the work without pricing it
summary: Reward-seeking empties service before the work is even done. Finish the work before ego sends its invoice.
takeaway: Finish the work before ego sends its invoice.
lifeApplication: When reward-thinking appears, complete the service without pricing it and refuse to call attention to yourself.
